seo.title: About Us — Venom Guitars
seo.description: The story behind Venom Guitars — an Australian custom guitar manufacturing dream built from passion for music.

s3.k2: A dream to build Australia's most recognisable custom guitar brand — from the ground up, note by note, coil by coil.

s4.k3: Venom Guitars was born from a simple but powerful idea — that Australia deserves its own world-class guitar brand. Not a badge-engineered import, not a cheap knockoff. A genuinely Australian instrument, built with care, using local materials, and reflecting the unique spirit of this country.
s4.k4: We started with a love of music, a workshop, and a stubborn refusal to settle for less than perfect. Every guitar we've built has pushed our craft further — better joinery, better finishes, better setups. The snake wrapped around that guitar in our logo isn't just a logo. It's a promise of something dangerous, beautiful, and alive.
s4.k5: Australia has some of the finest tonewoods in the world. Blackwood, Queensland Maple, Silky Oak — timbers with soul. Combined with international classics like Mahogany and Alder, our guitars sing with a character that's distinctly ours.
s4.k8: Every guitar built on Australian soil, by Australian hands.
s4.k10: We source sustainable Australian hardwoods for one-of-a-kind tone.
s4.k12: Professional-grade components and precision craftsmanship throughout.

s5.k4: Every aesthetic choice, from the resin art to the body contours, is deliberate. We design guitars that demand attention before a single note is played.
s5.k6: We're committed to being a supportive force in the Australian music scene — grassroots and professional musicians alike deserve great instruments.
s5.k8: From timbers to design motifs, every guitar carries the DNA of this continent. We're building something genuinely, unapologetically Australian.
s5.k10: No corners cut. Every fret dressed, every nut slotted precisely, every setup done properly. We take the time because the instrument deserves it.
s5.k12: We start Australian, but the goal is to put Venom Guitars on stages around the world. A brand that started in a workshop and ended up everywhere.
s5.k14: We share our knowledge openly — build videos, tutorials, and resources for anyone who wants to understand the craft of lutherie and the science of tone.

s6.k4: The concept for Venom Guitars forms — an Australian custom guitar brand with a distinctive identity and uncompromising quality standard.
s6.k6: Workshop established. First timber sourced. Prototype builds underway, testing designs, materials, and construction techniques.
s6.k8: Our flagship series launches — inspired by Australia's iconic Red Belly Black snake. Resin art bodies, hot pickups, and serious playability.
s6.k10: Venom Guitars launches across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. Build videos, education content, and community growth.
s6.k12: New series in development. Expanded custom build program. Education partnerships. The snake is just getting warmed up.

s7.k3: Small crew. Big ambition. Every person at Venom Guitars is a musician first and a craftsperson second.
s7.k6: The person behind the snake. Guitarist, woodworker, and relentless pursuer of the perfect tone. Has been building guitars longer than most people realise. Believes every player deserves a custom instrument.
s7.k9: Obsessed with surface prep, lacquer application, and fretwork. The person responsible for that moment when a guitar comes out of final polish and looks absolutely deadly. No blemish survives.
s7.k12: Wires every guitar by hand. Has rewound pickups more times than they can count. Responsible for the final setup — and for that look on a player's face when they plug in for the first time.
s7.k13: Want to join the Venom family? We occasionally take on apprentice luthiers.
